name: Forms, FAQs and two text columns

content.text: Marianna’s takes pride in providing an excellent, high-quality product for non-profit and community groups to sell as a fundraiser.

We welcome the opportunity to bring samples and present our program in person. During this FREE Product Presentation, your fundraising committee will have the chance to taste our products and learn how our program works, along with the benefits we offer to help maximize your success.
If you are interested in scheduling a FREE Product Sampling, please complete the form on this page.
Please Note:

Product presentations are limited to one per organization. Once a group has held a fundraiser with Marianna’s, additional product presentations are not available. To make the most of your presentation, we encourage inviting anyone within your organization who will be involved in planning or decision-making, so everyone has the opportunity to learn and ask questions together.

Presentations must be scheduled in a public meeting space such as a meeting hall, school, church, fire hall, or similar setting with adequate seating and table space for attendees. While we are flexible on the venue, it must be a publicly accessible location—presentations are not conducted in private homes.

items.question: Do you have a minimum order?

content.text: Yes, we do have a minimum requirement of at least 100 items.

If your first order with us falls below 100 items, we may ask you to meet our delivery truck at the nearest point along the delivery route. Please be aware that future orders will require a minimum of 100 items for delivery. Any future orders that fall below 100 items, you will be required to pick up the order at our facility in Tipton, PA (excluding Saturdays), or the order may be subject to cancellation.

items.question: Are your hoagies, pizzas, or dressings available at a retail location?

content.text: Our 14” hoagies and 12” pizzas are only available through fundraising events. Our specialty Italian Dressing and Sweet & Sassy Mayo are also exclusive to our fundraisers and cannot be purchased separately. If you are looking for a sale in your area, please complete the
Find a Sale
form and our Sales Team can help connect you with a local fundraiser.

items.question: Am I charged tax for my items?

content.text: Since hoagies are a prepared food and ready-to-eat, they are considered a taxable item. Pizzas need baked at home before consuming, so they are not considered taxable.
Allegheny County deliveries are subject to an additional 1% sales tax.
If applicable, a Sales Tax Exempt Form can be emailed to Customer Service at
mariannas@delgrossos.com
to be placed on file.
Please Note:

In PA, receiving an Employer Identification Number (EIN) does not imply State Sales Tax Exempt status. The EIN is simply a group's equivalent of a "Social Security Number." Similarly, a 501(c)(3) designation is a federal status, not a state one.
To qualify for sales tax exemption, we require a copy of your State Tax Exemption Certificate or a completed, signed, and dated PA REV-1220 form, which must include your State Tax ID.

Organizations must register with the Pennsylvania Department of Revenue to be recognized as tax-exempt. Exempt organizations are assigned exemption numbers beginning with "75," while schools are assigned numbers starting with "76." For further clarification, please consult the Pennsylvania Department of Revenue.
WV and MD have different forms that can be used for State Sales Tax Exemption.
